newsitem.title: USA: Kansas feedlot cattle Tuesday roundup - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Kansas feedlot cattle Tuesday roundup - USDA.

text.p: Trade was very slow on Tuesday, with not enough slaughter steer or heifer sales confirmed for an adequate market test, USDA said.

Inquiry fairly good, demand light. Sales confirmed on 200 slaughter steers and 800 slaughter heifers Tuesday. For the week to date 20,100 head confirmed, including 19,100 head previously contracted or formulated cattle.
Sales FOB feedlot net weights after 4 percent shrink.
Slaughter steers - Few Select with end Choice 2-3 1050-1125 lbs 68.00. Slaughter heifers - Few Select with end Choice 2-3 985-1075 lbs 68.00.
Confirmed - 1,000 week ago - 66,300 year ago - none
Wk to date - 20,100 week ago - 78,200 year ago - 8,000
